title: Autoclicker - Admitted on SS (FOR POSIGHDUN)

replies.author: Tazz
replies.body:
Seeing as I discussed this with Posighdun when your appeal was being sorted, and it will take a few years for Posighdun for respond to this, I'll do it.

First of all, your timezone is completely different to Posighduns, he is literally 12 hours in front of you.

You are not being unbanned because you cheated a month and a half ago, and admitted to autoclicking months before after having your autoclicker found.

I am 100% sure you will get a second chance, however you have only been banned for a month and a half.

Nova and Dawson were given a second chance after a very long time, and well, they are both currently banned. Both of their chances were at least 6 months after their ban. Eric on the other hand, didn't officially break a rule and could've appealed straight away. However, if it was down to me, he would still be banned for another 4 months because it was meant to be a 'permanent' ban.

I hope this helps you, and I am sure that in a couple of months you can and will get appealed and have a second chance.

If you still want Posighdun to answer you, I can forward this on to him, and make him reply, but he is basically going to say the same as me.
